articles.title: Amazon Has an Asus ROG Flow Z13 Ultra-Portable Gaming Laptop for (Way) Below $2,000 for Black Friday
articles.summary: For Black Friday, Amazon is offering the lowest price I've seen on ASUS' powerful ultraportable gaming convertible. You can pick up a brand new Asus ROG Flow Z13 gaming laptop with 32GB of RAM for just $1,699.99 with free shipping after a $400 off discount.
body: The Asus ROG Flow Z13 is a 13.4" 2-in-1 convertible laptop that weighs in at only 2.65 pounds without the detachable keyboard. That's about one pound heavier than the Xbox Ally X handheld, which weighs in at 1.6 pounds. With the keyboard, the Z13 weighs about 3.5 pounds. A premium laptop deserves premium build quality, and the Flow Z13 doesn't disappoint with a blacked out CNC aluminum alloy chassis and Corning Gorilla Glass Victus screen protection.

This particular configuration is equipped with a 13.4" 2560x1600 180Hz IPS display, AMD Ryzen AI Max 390 CPU with AMD Radeon 8050S iGPU, 32GB of LPDDR5X-8000Mhz RAM, and a 1TB SSD. This is less powerful than the highest end ROG Flow Z13, which comes equipped with a Ryzen AI Max 395 CPU with 8060S iGPU, but it's also far less expensive (currently the least expensive model is $2,100 ). The Radeon 8050S is more powerful than the Ryzen Z2 Extreme APU found in the highest-end handheld gaming PCs like the ROG Xbox Ally X.

articles.title: Rockstar Games Has A GTA 6 Hit On Its Hands, But Its Union Vote Is A Loss
articles.summary: Roughly 75% of Rockstar Games staff in the UK have voted against a formal recognition agreement with the Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain (IWGB). The news came in the wake of GTA 6 's record-breaking launch, and had the IWGB been recognized, Rockstar Games management would have been…
body: Voting took place across two weeks, and turnout was massive, with over 93% of UK staff casting their ballot (roughly 1,544 employees). The IWGB said it was undeterred by the result and would continue working to build support among Rockstar employees. "While the result means Rockstar will not be formally required to hold regular meetings with union representatives under a recognition agreement, it does not prevent workers from continuing to organize and push for workplace improvements through the IWGB, joining the union or exercising their individual trade union rights and protections," the union said in a statement.

The vote also comes hot on the heels of the IWGB taking Rockstar to an employment tribunal, alleging unlawful dismissal and union busting after it fired over 30 employees last year for gross misconduct over alleged leaks of confidential information. Closing submissions were wrapped up shortly before the vote results came out, and a ruling is still pending. While game dev unionizing has gained significant momentum over the years, a decisive loss at one of the industry's biggest studios could be a notable speed bump for union organizers.
points: Roughly 75% of Rockstar Games staff in the UK have voted against a formal recognition agreement with the Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain (IWGB).

articles.title: Microsoft-Owned GitHub Stuns Followers as It Celebrates AnyPS5 Repo in Now-Deleted Tweet
articles.summary: In a post that’s since been deleted, Microsoft-owned code and software collaboration site GitHub celebrated the AnyPS5 repo “passing 58k stars” from users on the platform as a result of the launch of GTA 6.
body: “GTA 6 is finally here, sparking one of the biggest weeks in gaming and open source on GitHub,” the post said, before jumping into celebrating the repo. “Does changing where games run cross a legal line?” the tweet asked.

There was also an official video attached to the tweet, which highlighted a post from an AnyPS5 coder, via Kotaku. The post in the video said: “We have 3 days until GTA 6 everyone get your agents or deevs[sic] and work.”

While the post could easily be the work of a rogue social media person, the optics aren’t good at all. GTA 6 is only officially available on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S, so both Sony and Microsoft have benefited greatly from the game's record-breaking launch. To see a the Microsoft-owned GitHub post a message to its followers essentially encouraging potential piracy is remarkable.
IGN has asked for comment, but GitHub obviously realized its mistake — it deleted the tweet, after all — but how it even got approved in the first place is a mystery until the company comments.

articles.title: GTA 6’s Furry Rescue Mission Is A Little Weird, But The Rewards Are Worth It
articles.summary: No matter what you do in GTA 6, it pales in comparison to being a Furry in that game. Anyone looking to externalize their inner animal spirit is in danger of being hunted, and you'll find out for yourself just how much the fictional state of Leonida hates Furries when you're given the chance to…
body: Like several other missions in GTA 6, helping out the Furry resistance appears to trigger randomly. The mission takes place after Chapter 3, on Miramar Drive in Crosstown, Vice City, and you'll want to be cruising around that area at night, between midnight and 4 AM.
Once it starts, you'll see cops pull up to hunt down a Furry by the name of Chase, and if you drive up to him, you can either give him a lift or leave him to his brutal fate.
If you do choose to help Chase, then get ready to be hunted down by cops. You'll pick up a three-star Wanted level, which means the cops will be in mildly hot pursuit of your vehicle.
Chase will direct you to a nearby parking garage, where his Furry allies are waiting. After a short standoff, they'll welcome you into their ranks as an honorary Furry.

articles.title: GTA 6 Developers Have Voted Against Unionization by 75% to 25%
articles.summary: Rockstar Games' UK workforce has voted firmly against unionization the week after the studio's latest game, Grand Theft Auto 6, demolished sales records.
body: The vote was 25% in favor of and 75% against a recognition agreement with the IWGB Game Workers Union. It's a decisive result, especially considering a 93.2% turnout for the vote, with 1,544 employees from Rockstar's offices in Edinburgh, Leeds, Lincoln, Dundee, and London participating.

The two-week ballot coincided not just with GTA 6 's launch, but with an employment tribunal hearing over the firing of 31 Rockstar workers in 2025. Rockstar argued the workers had leaked company secrets, while the IWGB characterized the action as union-busting. A judgment in the case is pending.

The union can continue to represent individual members, and Rockstar staff remain free to organize over pay, overtime, and other issues, but Rockstar management will not be formally required to meet or negotiate with union reps.
Rockstar Games head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe said in a statement that the company was "extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we've built together and the launch of GTA 6."

articles.title: Prime Video Is Saying Goodbye to Six Decades of James Bond Movies
articles.summary: James Bond fans looking to revisit the legendary spy's cinematic adventures might want to clear their schedules before the end of November. Prime Video is preparing to remove a huge chunk of the 007 franchise from its streaming library, with nearly every James Bond movie currently available on the…
body: A total of 26 Bond films are listed among Prime Video's upcoming departures, spanning more than six decades of the franchise. That includes everything from Sean Connery's debut as 007 in Dr. No to Daniel Craig's final outing in No Time to Die.

That leaves a pretty substantial gap in Prime Video's Bond collection, particularly for anyone hoping to revisit the franchise in chronological order. The list also includes Never Say Never Again, the unofficial Bond film starring Connery that was released outside the main Eon Productions series.

The departures come at an interesting time for the franchise, too, as Amazon MGM Studios prepares its next James Bond movie. Robert Pattinson has recently been announced as the seventh actor to take on the iconic role, with Dune filmmaker Denis Villeneuve attached to direct.

While details about the upcoming movie remain limited, Amazon is reportedly targeting a 2028 release. With a new era of Bond on the horizon, now might be a good time to revisit the franchise's previous adventures. Just don't wait until December to do it on Prime Video.

articles.title: GTA 6 reportedly sets massive livestreaming record, watched more in its first week than Elden Ring, Diablo 4, Valorant, and Lost Ark combined
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 has broken another livestreaming record. After attracting more viewers across livestreaming platforms than any game ever on its launch day, Rockstar's open-world crime sim has reportedly continued to dominate on platforms like Twitch, YouTube, and Kick.
body: Over its first seven days on sale, GTA 6 has amassed over 420m hours watched, according to Streams Charts. That's nearly three times more than the previous record, held by Valorant's closed beta in April 2020. In fact, that 420m hours tally is more than the first-week watch time achieved by Valorant, Elden Ring, Diablo 4, and Lost Ark combined.

As for the livestreaming platforms that saw the largest audiences for GTA 6, YouTube reportedly had the lead in average audience numbers during the first six hours of launch, but Twitch took over in content volume in the days that followed. In fact, Twitch's GTA 6 watch time was higher at launch than any other game in its history.

Streams Charts also noted 1,056 channels reached new all-time peak viewership numbers while streaming GTA 6, in some cases multiplying their previous record tenfold. Major content creators like IShowSpeed, IlloJuan, and TheBurntPeanut stole the spotlight, but GTA 6 also helped many other channels set new viewership records.

articles.title: Rockstar Games employees vote against union recognition
articles.summary: Rockstar Games employees have voted against official recognition of the Rockstar Game Workers Union, with 93.2 percent of staff participating in the vote.
body: 25 percent of those who participated voted to recognise the union, while 75 percent voted against. If it had been approved, it would have been the largest recognised union in the UK video game industry by a large margin. While the union will still exist and organise, Rockstar Games will not have to recognise the union as a representing body for staff at the studio, and is not obligated to attend regular meetings with the body.

Jennifer Kolbe, head of publishing at Rockstar Games told Eurogamer: "We are extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we've built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6. This result reflects our team's strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong. As we look ahead, we're excited to build on all we've accomplished together."

articles.title: We are already in a world where people think about promoting games as human-made, Citizen Sleeper creator says
articles.summary: Citizen Sleeper creator Gareth Damian Martin - also known by their studio name Jump Over the Age - believes we're reaching a point of gen-AI saturation whereby game-makers are starting to counter-promote games as being human-made.
body: "We already are. Yeah, yeah, yeah. 100 percent," Damian Martin told me in an interview, while discussing their striking new game Signet City. "That was already something that my publisher [Fellow Traveller] was saying they want to do with my games more, especially with me doing the art this time as well. Yeah, 100 percent - it's going to give rise to that."

It's a label I haven't seen circulating in games yet, but we have seen an increase in the number of AI disclosures for games being sold on Steam, and many videos on YouTube now carry 'No AI' badges, in an effort to stand out from the torrent of videos made using gen-AI. We are already seeing Steam events dedicated to games without any AI usage whatsoever. Things are clearly changing.

Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam), and Xbox Series X|S.
